note: Planning data, not a game file. 'picked' = in the launch roster (12 Playable + 2 Secret) or the twist villain. 'use' is one of Playable, Boss, Enemy, Ally, Secret, Later.

species.fact: Largest living marsupial. Males box each other, leaning back on the tail to kick with both feet.
species.idea: Champion fighter: two-footed kick and a tail-balanced counter; huge bounding jumps.
species.size: Males ~1.5–1.8 m tall, up to ~85 kg

species.fact: Lives in large mobs; very fast over short distances.
species.idea: Mobs of greys charge across the screen in waves.

species.fact: Males are nicknamed "stinkers" for their strong, curry-like smell.
species.idea: Stink cloud that makes enemies flee.

species.fact: Common in eastern Australia; small feral colonies also live on the Isle of Man and Ireland's Lambay Island.
species.idea: All-rounder; secret Isle of Man bonus level.

species.fact: Striped, ring-tailed wallaby that leaps between cliff ledges.
species.idea: Wall jumps and cliff runs; best climber in the game.

species.fact: Nicknamed "the happiest animal" for its smiley face; most live on Rottnest Island.
species.idea: TWIST, the secret villains: they smile for the tourists on their island while plotting to take over the mainland. Their grin hypnotises you if you look too long.

species.fact: A kangaroo that lives in trees: climbs trunks and leaps between branches.
species.idea: Climbs trees and walls, drops onto enemies from above.

species.fact: Golden-red tree-kangaroo from the cloud forests of Papua New Guinea.
species.idea: Mentor for a New Guinea rainforest world.

species.fact: Small, stocky forest wallaby that thumps its feet as an alarm.
species.idea: Foot-thump alarm calls in more enemies.

species.fact: Rat-kangaroo that digs up underground fungi and carries nest grass with its curled tail.
species.idea: Digs up hidden items and power-ups.

species.fact: Smallest kangaroo relative; gallops on all fours instead of hopping.
species.idea: Joke unlockable who refuses to hop.

species.fact: Makes cube-shaped poo; its tough, plated rump blocks its burrow; can sprint ~40 km/h.
species.idea: Bum-block shield, stackable cube projectiles, surprise sprint.

species.fact: One of the world's rarest mammals; only a few hundred survive in Queensland.
species.idea: Rescue-mission NPC.

species.fact: Sleeps up to ~20 hours a day on a low-energy eucalyptus diet; males give a deep, loud bellow.
species.idea: Power nap heals; bellow shockwave; climbs trees.

species.fact: Bold city possum known for noisy fights in roofs at night; a major pest in New Zealand.
species.idea: Cheeky city scrapper: raids roofs, flings bins, screeches. Hometown hero of the city levels.
species.where: Most of Australia; invasive in NZ

species.fact: Grips branches with its curled, prehensile tail.
species.idea: Swings from its tail on vines.

species.fact: Glides between trees on skin flaps, up to ~50 m.
species.idea: Glides across gaps; dive-bomb attack.

species.fact: Largest gliding marsupial; can glide up to ~100 m.
species.idea: Carries a teammate across huge gaps.

species.fact: World's smallest gliding mammal: mouse-sized, with a feather-shaped tail.
species.idea: Tiny secret character.

species.fact: Tiny nectar-feeder with a long, brush-tipped tongue.
species.idea: Collects nectar power-ups for the team.

species.fact: Lives only in the alpine zone and hibernates under the snow.
species.idea: Guide for the snowy Alps level.

species.fact: Slow-moving, sloth-like possum relative.
species.idea: Crossover cameo from Sloth Slap.

species.fact: Strongest bite for its size of any living mammal; screeches when feeding.
species.idea: Bite combos; a screech that stuns.

species.fact: Largest surviving marsupial carnivore on the mainland; an agile climber.
species.idea: Fast, pouncing rival boss.

species.fact: Dies after eating poisonous cane toads; scientists have trained quolls to avoid them.
species.idea: Story ally threatened by the Cane Toad King.

species.fact: Eats up to ~20,000 termites a day with a ~10 cm tongue; active by day.
species.idea: Tongue grab pulls in enemies and items.

species.fact: Feisty little desert hunter with a black brush-tipped tail.
species.idea: Desert ambush enemies.

species.fact: The last known one died in 1936; it could open its jaws extremely wide.
species.idea: Legendary unlockable "ghost" character.

species.fact: Huge ears; digs spiral burrows; Australia's "Easter Bilby" stands in for the invasive rabbit.
species.idea: Burrow dash; ear radar spots hidden enemies; arch-rival of the rabbits.

species.fact: Fast digger brought back from the brink in Victoria.
species.idea: Quick-digging ally. Keep its look original, nothing like a famous video-game bandicoot.

species.fact: Blind and ear-less; "swims" through desert sand.
species.idea: Travels underground and pops up under enemies.

species.fact: North America's only marsupial; plays dead; resists many snake venoms; has 50 teeth.
species.idea: Play-dead dodge; venom immunity; the American guest fighter.

species.fact: The only truly aquatic marsupial: webbed hind feet and a watertight pouch.
species.idea: Star of the swimming levels.

species.fact: Lives in South America but is more closely related to Australia's marsupials than to other American ones.
species.idea: Lore character: the "missing link".

species.fact: Largest marsupial ever, rhino-sized; extinct about 40,000 years ago.
species.idea: Giant time-travel boss.

species.fact: Extinct predator with one of the strongest bites for its size of any mammal, and huge thumb claws.
species.idea: Time-travel boss.

species.fact: Extinct kangaroo about 2 m tall, with a single hoof-like toe on each foot.
species.idea: Time-travel kangaroo boss.
